title: 第1章 废后(1)
content_zh:
初夏的天，到了傍晚，滂沱大雨总是突然而至。
天色阴沉沉的，乌云压在端庄大气的宫墙之上，原先金碧辉煌的宫殿在暗云笼罩下暗沉下来，仿佛巨大的囚笼，将里头的人困得牢牢实实。
宽大的寝殿，纱帘似乎都很陈旧了，落着厚厚的灰尘。本是炎热的天气，竟也能觉出些许冷意。地上散乱着衣裳和首饰，仿佛刚刚经历了一场浩劫。
女子半跪在地上，仰头看着面前的人。
这女子不过而立之年，面容却苍老似老妪，眉目间沉沉戾气，一双眼睛死水微澜，肖似遗落许久干枯的枯井，流不出眼泪，却又带着深不见底的恨意。
“娘娘，请吧。”身边的太监手捧着洁白绢帛，语气里是止不住的不耐：“杂家还等着向陛下复命呢。”
沈妙的目光落在太监身上，沉默半晌，才慢慢开口，声音含着混沌的嘶哑：“小李子，本宫当初提拔你的时候，你还是高公公身边的一条狗。”
太监倨傲的微微昂头：“娘娘，今时不同往日。”
“今时不同往日……”沈妙喃喃道，突然仰头大笑：“好一个今时不同往日！”
只因一句“今时不同往日”，那些从前见了她毕恭毕敬的臣子奴仆如今可以对她呼来喝去，因为“今时不同往日”，她就要落一个三尺白绫身首异处的下场。往日是个什么往日，今时又是从哪里开始的今时？是从楣夫人进宫开始，还是从太子被废开始，亦或是长公主和亲远嫁惨死途中开始？再是她从秦国人质五年再回宫开始？

“往日”到“今时”，皇后到废后，不过是因为傅修宜的一句话！这满朝文武就能变了脸色，这明齐江山就能颠倒黑白！好一个“今时不同往日”！
寝殿的门“吱呀”一声开了，一双绣着龙纹的青靴停在沈妙面前。往上，是明黄的袍角。
“看在你跟在朕二十年的份上，朕赐你全尸，谢恩吧。”天子道。
沈妙慢慢的仰起头，看着高高在上的男人，时间没有在他脸上留下任何印迹，一如当初的丰神俊朗，他是天下明君，名正言顺的天子，是她痴恋了二十年的男人，相濡以沫走过来的丈夫。现在对她说：“朕赐你全尸，谢恩吧。”
“为什么？”沈妙艰难的问。
他没有回答。
“为什么，要抄了沈家满门？”她问。
定王傅修宜，先皇育九子，九子各有千秋，偏太子多病，先皇又迟迟不肯改立太子，皇子夺嫡风云际会。她爱慕定王风华绝代，不顾家里的劝阻，终于得偿所愿，却也将整个沈家和定王绑在了一块。
正因为如此，她尽心尽力的辅佐定王，从什么都不知的娇娇女儿到朝堂之事也会参与的王妃，出谋划策，也终于定下江山。傅修宜登基那一日，立她为后，母仪天下，好不风光。

她以为她是最风光的皇后了，皇子叛乱刚平定，明齐根基不稳，匈奴来犯，邻国虎视眈眈，为了借兵，沈妙自愿去了秦国做人质，走的时候，女儿儿子尚且足月，傅修宜还说：“朕会亲自将你接回来。”
五年后，她终于再回明齐，后宫中却多了一个美貌才情皆是上乘的楣夫人。
content_en:
In early summer, in the evening, heavy rain always comes suddenly.
The sky was gloomy, and dark clouds were pressing on the dignified and majestic palace walls. The originally magnificent palace darkened under the dark clouds, like a huge cage, trapping the people inside tightly.
In the large bedroom, the gauze curtains seemed to be old and covered with thick dust. It's a hot weather, but I can actually feel a little chilly. Clothes and jewelry were scattered on the ground, as if they had just experienced a catastrophe.
The woman was half kneeling on the ground, looking up at the person in front of her.
This woman was only 30 years old, but her face was as old as that of an old woman, her brows were full of anger, and her eyes were stagnant, like a dry well that had been left dry for a long time, unable to shed tears, but filled with bottomless hatred.
"Your Majesty, please." The eunuch beside him held a white silk in his hand and said with uncontrollable impatience, "The Za family are still waiting to return to Your Majesty."
Shen Miao's eyes fell on the eunuch, she was silent for a long time, and then she slowly spoke, her voice contained a chaotic hoarse voice: "Little Lizi, when I promoted you, you were still a dog beside Eunuch Gao."
The eunuch raised his head slightly arrogantly: "My Lady, these days are different from the past."
"Today is different from the past..." Shen Miao murmured and suddenly raised her head and laughed: "What a difference from the past!"
Just because of the words "Today is different from the past", those ministers and servants who used to treat her respectfully can now yell at her. Because "Today is different from the past", she will end up with a three-foot white silk silk with a missing head. What was the past, and where did the present begin? Did it start when Mrs. Mei entered the palace, or when the prince was deposed, or when the eldest princess married a relative and died tragically? What about her return to the palace after being a hostage of Qin for five years?
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
From "the past" to "the present", from the queen to the deposed queen, it was just because of Fu Xiuyi's words! The civil and military officials of the entire dynasty can change their faces, and the country of Ming Qi can reverse right and wrong! What a "Today is different from the past"!
The door of the dormitory opened with a creak, and a pair of green boots embroidered with dragon patterns stopped in front of Shen Miao. Upward, there are bright yellow robe corners.
"Because you have been with me for twenty years, I will give you the whole body. Thank you." The emperor said.
Shen Miao slowly raised her head and looked at the tall man. Time did not leave any mark on his face. He was just as handsome as before. He was the wise king of the world, the justifiable emperor, the man she had been infatuated with for twenty years, and the husband she had walked through. Now say to her: "I give you the whole body, thank you."
"Why?" Shen Miao asked with difficulty.
He didn't answer.
"Why did you want to confiscate the entire Shen family?" she asked.
Prince Ding Fu Xiuyi, the late emperor raised nine sons, each of whom had his own merits, but the prince was often sick, and the late emperor was reluctant to change the crown prince, so the prince took the throne from his direct descendants. She admired Prince Ding for his unparalleled splendor, and despite her family's dissuasion, she finally got her wish, but she also tied the entire Shen family to Prince Ding.
Because of this, she tried her best to assist King Ding. From a charming daughter who knew nothing to a princess who was also involved in court affairs, she made suggestions and finally decided to rule the country. On the day when Fu Xiu Yi ascended the throne, he appointed her as his queen, and her mother-in-law treated the world with great honor.
She thought she was the most glorious queen. The prince's rebellion had just been put down, the foundation of the Ming Qi was unstable, the Xiongnu invaded, and neighboring countries were watching eagerly. In order to borrow troops, Shen Miao volunteered to go to Qin as a hostage. When she left, her daughter and son were still full-term. Fu Xiuyi also said: "I will personally take you back."
Five years later, she finally returned to Mingqi, and there was a beautiful and talented Mrs. Mei in the harem.
